title: First-Late Percentages on Credit Builder Accounts Late Fees
content:
The percent at which a Credit Builder late fee is charged depends on the account's late-fee history and on how long the account has been open. This applies to a Credit Builder late fee for a late due date with no more than one debit card payment credited toward it.

## Rates

- An account with no late fee charged in the 12 whole calendar months before the assessment date (a fee dated on the assessment date counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them) that has been open 12 months or more pays the seasoned first-late percent of 3.0 instead of the plan's late-fee percent.
- An account with no late fee charged in those 12 months that has been open fewer than 12 months pays the new-account first-late percent of 4.0 instead.
- An account with one or more late fees charged in those 12 months pays the plan's late-fee percent.

The assessment date is the date the late fee is charged, today. Months open are whole calendar months from the open date (the date the account activated), each complete on the day of the month matching the opening day or, in a month too short for that day, on the first day of the following month. The late fees counted are the account's late-fee entries, by their dates.

| Late fees charged on the account in the 12 months | Months open | Percent |
|---|---|---|
| none | 12 or more | 3.0 |
| none | fewer than 12 | 4.0 |
| one or more | any | the plan's late-fee percent |

## Boundaries (hypothetical dates)

Assessment date 15 March:

| Earlier late fee dated | Inside the 12 months? |
|---|---|
| 15 March of the previous year | no, it falls outside |
| 16 March of the previous year | yes |
| 15 March, the assessment date itself | yes, it counts |

| Open date | Date | Whole months open |
|---|---|---|
| 10 April | 9 April of the next year | 11 |
| 10 April | 10 April of the next year | 12 |
| 31 August | 28 February of the next year (28 days) | 5 |
| 31 August | 1 March of the next year | 6 |
